</nav> <script></script>  <main data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <!-- Intro --> <section class="kite-hero section section--dark" aria-labelledby="kite-title" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <div class="kite-hero__inner container" data-reveal data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <p class="eyebrow kite-hero__eye" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Kitesurfing</p> <h1 class="kite-hero__title display" id="kite-title" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Kitesurfing in Icaraizinho</h1> <div class="divider-gold" style="margin:1.4rem 0" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen></div> <p class="kite-hero__intro" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Icaraí de Amontada — the beach everyone calls Icaraizinho — lies on the west coast of Ceará, about 190 km from Fortaleza. Between July and January the wind blows steadily, and the water is flat and shallow — the combination that makes this a place sought out by people learning their first water start and by riders who have been on the water for years.</p> </div> </section> <!-- Le spot --> <section class="section section--surface" aria-labelledby="kite-spot-title" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <div class="kite-spot container" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <h2 class="kite-spot__title display" id="kite-spot-title" data-reveal data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>The spot</h2> <div class="kite-spot__grid" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <article class="kite-spot__item" data-reveal data-delay="1" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <h3 class="kite-spot__label eyebrow" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Where it is</h3> <p class="kite-spot__text" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Icaraizinho de Amontada, on the west coast of Ceará, roughly 190 km from Fortaleza. A fishing village that grew up around the wind without losing its slow pace.</p> </article><article class="kite-spot__item" data-reveal data-delay="2" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <h3 class="kite-spot__label eyebrow" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Wind season</h3> <p class="kite-spot__text" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>From July to January the wind is steady. That changes how you plan a trip: instead of waiting for the right window, you plan sessions around the day — ride in the morning, rest through the heat, go back out late in the afternoon.</p> </article><article class="kite-spot__item" data-reveal data-delay="3" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <h3 class="kite-spot__label eyebrow" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Flat, shallow water</h3> <p class="kite-spot__text" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Flat, shallow water favours learning. You can stand up across much of the riding area, which makes the first water starts less intimidating and getting your board back far easier. For experienced riders, a smooth surface is the natural ground for freestyle and technical progression.</p> </article><article class="kite-spot__item" data-reveal data-delay="1" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <h3 class="kite-spot__label eyebrow" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>50 metres from the beach</h3> <p class="kite-spot__text" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>The pousada is 50 metres from the beach. Your gear stays close, lunch happens between two sessions, and the daily commute stops being something to solve.</p> </article> </div> </div> </section> <!-- Club partenaire --> <section class="section section--dark" aria-labelledby="kite-club-title" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <div class="kite-club container" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <div class="kite-club__head" data-reveal data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <p class="eyebrow kite-club__eye" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Partner club</p> <h2 class="kite-club__title display" id="kite-club-title" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Cabana do Kite</h2> <div class="divider-gold" style="margin:1.2rem 0" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen></div> <p class="kite-club__intro" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>The village kite school and club is right next door. Lessons, gear, downwinders and a full beach setup — here is what they offer.</p> </div> <div class="kite-club__grid" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <article class="kite-club__card" data-reveal data-delay="1" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <h3 class="kite-club__card-title" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Lessons and coaching</h3> <ul class="kite-club__list" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Kitesurf and wing lessons, from day one to advanced level</li><li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>IKO and ABK certified instructors</li><li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Technical coaching and work on manoeuvres</li><li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Group or private lessons</li> </ul> </article><article class="kite-club__card" data-reveal data-delay="2" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <h3 class="kite-club__card-title" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Downwinders</h3> <ul class="kite-club__list" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Guided downwinders from 5 to 50 km</li><li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>4x4 transport included</li> </ul> </article><article class="kite-club__card" data-reveal data-delay="3" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <h3 class="kite-club__card-title" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Gear and facilities</h3> <ul class="kite-club__list" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Equipment rental: ION, Duotone, North, Ozone and F-One</li><li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Compressors on site and repairs done there</li><li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Secure gear storage on the beach</li> </ul> </article><article class="kite-club__card" data-reveal data-delay="1" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <h3 class="kite-club__card-title" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>On the beach</h3> <ul class="kite-club__list" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Beach bar and restaurant with fresh fish and seafood</li><li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Live music at sunset</li><li data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>A small shop</li> </ul> </article> data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Languages spoken</span> <span data-astro-cid-2sngbmen>Portuguese · English · French · Spanish</span> </p> <div class="kite-club__actions" data-astro-cid-2sngbmen> <a
